trigger.Name: BossActivateSuperPower
trigger.script: local SuperPower = random(1,3) AddImportantFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_carsen_activate_super_power") if SuperPower == 1 then TActivate("BossTpAura") TActivate("BossTimeoutTpAura") elseif SuperPower == 2 then TActivate("BossTimeoutVampir") end

trigger.Name: BossTpAura
trigger.script: local speedpl = GetSpeed(GetPlayerVehicle()) local rotpl = GetPlayerVehicle():GetRotation(Quaternion()) local coord = GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition() local tpaurarand = random(1,2) if tpaurarand == 1 then coord.x = coord.x + random(5,10) coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z + random(5,10) getObj("Carsen_vehicle_0"):SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(coord)) getObj("Carsen_vehicle_0"):SetRotation(Quaternion(rotpl)) elseif tpaurarand == 2 then coord.x = coord.x - random(5,10) coord.y = coord.y + 0 coord.z = coord.z - random(5,10) getObj("Carsen_vehicle_0"):SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(coord)) getObj("Carsen_vehicle_0"):SetRotation(Quaternion(rotpl)) end getObj("Carsen_vehicle_0"):SetCustomLinearVelocity(speedpl /3.6)
